opening.argument: The speaker presents a paid arbitrage bot alongside a daily-income promise. He says it can earn "aroud 10-20$ per day" and offers a base plan for "49.99 USDT", directing viewers toward paid access for the trading tool. The setup also requires viewers to find their API key and API secret, then enable permissions so the bot can trade automatically. That combination ties an easy-income solicitation to a concrete account-control risk: viewers are encouraged to purchase access and provide trading credentials, while the stated limitation is that the evidence establishes the solicitation and risk, not any particular loss or outcome.
